findings.description: [CWE-73] reclaimOrphanWorktrees blind fs.rm(dir,{recursive}) fallback deletes arbitrary old child dirs if FOREMAN_AIDER_WORKTREE_ROOT is misconfigured to a real directory - violates 'never mutate the tree' (Ephemeral worktree filesystem threat row). Moderator: CONFIRMED but downgraded CRITICAL->HIGH (misconfig-gated; default root is dedicated+safe). Fix: prune only dlg_-named dirs, drop blind fs.rm.

Trailing worktree_torn_down (no outcome, in finally) re-opens a FAILED delegation whose patch_checked already set outcome:fail; openDelegation treats last event as open, so validation_completed can later mask the worker's fail - defeats the P5 adversarial-gate-pass discipline gate (Adversarial gate-pass threat row). Moderator: CONFIRMED HIGH (traced; invoke_worker keeps fail as terminal-last). Fix: carry failure outcome onto the finally teardown event.

[CWE-200] Outbound secret gate scans only editable files[]; read_only_files are sent to the harness as aider context and can leak a secret to the endpoint (Local vLLM endpoint threat row). Moderator: CONFIRMED HIGH (dup gemini#1). Fix: scan editable+read-only contents.

Interpreter-resolve-fail returns WORKER_AIDER_EXIT; spec Error Handling maps aider/python-not-resolvable to WORKER_BINARY_NOT_FOUND (text-only in p2). TextFailureStage omits it. Moderator: CONFIRMED MEDIUM (brief conflated the stages). Fix: add WORKER_BINARY_NOT_FOUND to the union + use it for resolve-fail.

[CWE-209] safeAppend pushes raw appendEvent err.message (may include the sidecar absolute path) into the returned warning without scrub/bound. Moderator: CONFIRMED LOW (inherited from invoke_worker pattern). Fix: scrub+bound the warning.

[CWE-200] read_only_files bypass the outbound secret gate (findSecrets scans only editable fileContents; read_only_fnames still reach aider->LLM). Moderator: CONFIRMED HIGH (dup codex#3). Fix: include read-only contents in the scan.

(b) unlistedTarget scope-enforcement is dead code because diffWorktree(worktree,files) scopes git diff to files[], so targetPaths never contains an out-of-scope path; proposed fix = diff whole worktree. Moderator: REJECTED - diffing the whole worktree CONTRADICTS spec R3 (git diff -- <files> is intentionally scoped; out-of-scope aider edits are safely excluded + worktree destroyed). The check is harmless defense-in-depth; keep the R3 scoping.

(c) diffWorktree ignores runGit exitCode; a git-diff failure returns {diff:'',truncated:false} -> misclassified downstream as WORKER_GHOST (empty patch). Moderator: CONFIRMED MEDIUM. Fix: throw on non-truncated nonzero exit (fail loud); graceful catch joins the deferred P4 git-infra taxonomy item.

(d) Test gaps: no coverage for MODEL_SCHEMA_FAIL (fixture badjson mode), WORKER_AIDER_LLM_ERROR (error_kind!=none), WORKER_RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE (diff truncation). Moderator: CONFIRMED LOW. Fix: add badjson + error_kind fixture tests.

findings.description: [CWE-345] Refunded-infra failure on the LATEST delegation is treated as clean; a ledger 'pass' whose latest sidecar delegation ended outcome:fail/WORKER_AIDER_EXIT passes the gate silently, no override. Argues spec ambiguity: §322 clause2 says clean only when FINAL terminal outcome is 'pass'. Weakens 'Adversarial gate-pass under user pressure'.

[CWE-693] Absent/deleted/mislocated sidecar -> gate skips delegated units (default reader discards absent flag). REJECTED by moderator: unit.w (ledger delegation) does NOT imply a sidecar delegation exists; pit-boss Agent-tool delegations (all of P1-P5) legitimately emit NO sidecar events, so §318 mandates NONE->SKIP. Codex's fix would make the gate un-passable for the standard workflow. Contradicts §318.

[CWE-345] Gate does not require terminal event_type==='validation_completed'; any last event with outcome:'pass' is accepted as a clean terminal. §320 requires a terminal validation_completed event. CONFIRMED spec-literal gap; will require event_type==='validation_completed' for the clean-pass classification.

[CWE-354] Torn-tail readEvents warning discarded by the gate reader. REJECTED as a defect by moderator: a torn tail (interrupted append) is NOT a chain break — hash mismatch/chain break DO throw (tested), satisfying §319 'broken chain->THROW LOUD'; torn-tail is fail-closed (a torn terminal makes the delegation look open -> BLOCK). Optional future hardening: surface the warning.

[CWE-863] Refund-handling logic bypass (converges with codex#1): a refunded final delegation is treated as clean, so a ledger 'pass' with no terminal 'pass' passes the gate silently without user_override. Weakens 'Adversarial gate-pass under user pressure'. Genuine §322 clause1-vs-clause2 ambiguity -> escalating to user for arbitration.
Missing strict terminal validation_completed event-type check (§320) — converges with codex#3. Resolver checks outcome!==undefined but not event_type==='validation_completed'. CONFIRMED.
Test codifies refunded(WORKER_AIDER_EXIT)->pass-without-override (the disputed behavior). Tied to the §322 arbitration; the test's expectation changes iff the strict reading is adopted.

[CWE-UNMAPPED unbounded-value; not a telemetry-tag] Raw unitId interpolated into the DISCIPLINE ADHERENCE throw (ledger unit_id allowed up to 10000 chars) while resolveUnitDelegation uses boundIdentifier for matching. Minor consistency nit — the error string is not a bounded telemetry tag (sidecar/metric tags ARE bounded), but bounding keeps parity with the 3a CAP_WAIVER fix. Low.

[CWE-345/863] refunded-latest semantics: RESOLVED via user arbitration (strict/fail-closed). Only validation_completed{pass} is clean; a refunded-infra failure on the latest delegation is now a contradiction (BLOCK unless recorded user_override). Remediated in the 5a/5b fix round.
Finding B (§320 validation_completed event-type check): RESOLVED — resolver now requires event_type==='validation_completed' for the clean-pass classification.
Finding E (unbounded unitId in throw): RESOLVED — unitId wrapped in boundIdentifier() in both DISCIPLINE ADHERENCE messages; raw unit_id retained only in the durable discipline_overrides record.

Codex 'absent sidecar disables enforcement': REJECTED — §318 mandates NONE->SKIP for native/Agent-delegated units (unit.w != sidecar delegation); the proposed fix would make the gate un-passable for the standard pit-boss workflow (all P1-P5). No change.

Codex 'torn-tail warning absorbed': REJECTED as a defect — a torn tail != a chain break (hash mismatch/tamper DO throw, §319 satisfied); torn-tail is fail-closed (torn terminal -> looks open -> BLOCK). Optional future hardening only. No change.
